stringDomain: Valid Unicode representable as UTF-8; object keys have the same restriction.
excludedScenarios: Standalone surrogate string input to evaluation or public helpers
Parsing a string escape that produces a lone surrogate
Evaluating a string escape that produces a lone surrogate
Splitting an emoji on the empty separator into surrogate halves
Slicing only one code unit of an emoji
Truncating emoji padding to one surrogate code unit
Supplying lone surrogate halves for later concatenation
countSemantics: Reviewed scenario categories, not counts of supported features or passing assertions.
inScope: Valid Unicode input and output, including emoji
Reactive streams, subscriptions, retain/release and mixed Stream/Promise values
otherExclusions: Documentation APIs, data, context preparation and localization tooling (JS/V8-only)
v8OnlyReason: Documentation APIs, data, context preparation and localization tooling remain exclusively in the JS/V8 implementation by agreement; they are not Rust implementation gaps.
